tags.name: Github
tags.description: "description": "Endpoints for generating SVG cards from public GitHub repositories and user profiles."

get.description: Generates an SVG card containing information about a public GitHub repository. The returned SVG can be embedded directly in Markdown, HTML, or other applications that support SVG images.

schema.description: The GitHub username or organization that owns the repository.

parameters.description: The GitHub username or organization that owns the repository.
parameters.name: owner

schema.description: The name of the GitHub repository.

parameters.description: The name of the GitHub repository.
parameters.name: repo

schema.description: Color theme for the generated card.

parameters.description: Color theme for the generated card.
parameters.name: theme

404.description: The specified GitHub repository could not be found.

get.summary: Generate a user profile SVG card
get.description: Generates an SVG card containing information about a public GitHub user profile. The returned SVG can be embedded directly in Markdown, HTML, or other applications that support SVG images.

schema.description: The GitHub username whose profile card should be generated.

parameters.description: The GitHub username whose profile card should be generated.
parameters.name: username

schema.description: Color theme for the generated card.

parameters.description: Color theme for the generated card.
parameters.name: theme

200.description: SVG user profile card generated successfully.

404.description: The specified GitHub user could not be found.
